key_terms.الْمُنْظَرِينَ: The reprieved; those granted respite or delay in punishment or death

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be among the reprieved in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase is often interpreted as granting a specific period of respite (mu'ammara) to the disbelievers or a particular group, allowing them to experience the fullness of worldly life before their ultimate reckoning. This delay serves not as mercy but as a means of increasing their accountability, illustrating the divine wisdom behind the temporary nature of worldly existence for those destined for punishment.
